objective: Bounded read-only operational timing diagnostic to distinguish deterministic exact-time scheduler collision from broad fleet queue/serialization pressure using current live SparkBrain scheduler definitions, recent run timing, and durable worker generations; produce a reusable diagnosis without changing any scheduler or scientific/repository state outside Utility-owned state/results.

trigger_source.control_observation: Third consecutive Control scheduler-health observation reports broad start delays with no exact-time overlaps, autofix observation threshold met, but no evidence-based single phase target; scheduler_change_warranted=false.
trigger_source.prior_utility_task_deduplication: Distinct from prior registry-mirror reconciliation: this task analyzes runtime delay topology only and does not re-audit registry content.

prework_freshness.relay_ownership: NO_FRESH_ACTIVE_RELAY_CONTINUATION_OBSERVED; MAIN R49 completed static contract and requires fresh Analyst review before synthetic measurement

allowed_actions: Read current live SparkBrain scheduler definitions and last-run timestamps
Read current Control/Analyst/MAIN/SUB/Relay durable operational generations for collision/freshness context
Compute nominal phase spacing and observed start-delay pattern
Persist Utility-owned state and one append-only result
forbidden_actions: Any scheduler mutation or cadence/phase change
Any scientific workflow dispatch or experiment execution
Any work on CAND-RESOURCE-SEMANTIC-ACTIVE-WORK-LOCALIZATION-01 or its comparators/resource contract
Any creation or use of scientific identity
stop_condition: Stop after one cross-sectional delay-topology diagnosis, or immediately if assignment/current ceases to be clean IDLE or an ownership generation makes the diagnostic a hidden MAIN dependency.
